notes.title: Earth vs Mars - Demo Update (0.02.4195630)
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Increased unit variety on Downtown Showdown. This will make the level more strategic, meaning it will also be a little more difficult. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased difficulty on Independence Bay and Hazy Hills. Even experienced players will find these maps more challenging.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tutorial popup during city capture to help explain how capturing works[/p][/*][*][p]Added Next Unit button to the bottom of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed and reordered some options in the Settings menu for clarity and added a Key Bindings tab so that players have a keyboard reference.[/p][/*][/list]
